examined_formations.title: WEBSITE_DOWNTIME_TO_AD_PAUSE
examined_formations.chinese_title: 网站宕机触发广告自动暂停
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Website availability is external to the ad platform and campaign pause/resume is buyer-authorized. Boomerr currently monitors landing pages, pauses Google/Meta campaigns within roughly a minute of confirmed downtime, and auto-resumes on recovery. The exact trigger-to-action loop is already a commercial product.

examined_formations.title: DOMAIN_BLACKLIST_TO_OUTBOUND_PAUSE
examined_formations.chinese_title: 域名黑名单触发外呼邮件自动暂停
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Blacklist membership is externally determined and campaign pause is buyer-controlled. SmartReach scans major blacklists and automatically pauses active campaigns when a sending domain is flagged. The supposedly cross-system edge is already native in outreach tooling.

examined_formations.title: SUPPLIER_COST_CHANGE_TO_STORE_PRICE
examined_formations.chinese_title: 供应商成本变化触发店铺售价更新
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Supplier cost changes are external to the merchant store and price writes are buyer-controlled. DSers' 2026 Auto-Update Pricing recalculates store prices from changing supplier costs using pricing rules and is explicitly positioned as 24/7 margin protection. The mapping is already productized.

examined_formations.title: SERVICE_CAPACITY_TO_AD_DEMAND_CONTROL
examined_formations.chinese_title: 服务产能触发广告需求控制
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Technician/appointment capacity lives in an operations system while Google Ads is a separate action system. Capacity Engine connects ServiceTitan capacity, cancellations and schedules to automated bid, budget, messaging and campaign-pause actions, including pausing when fully booked. The cross-system rule bridge is already the core product.

examined_formations.title: SUPPLIER_UNAVAILABLE_TO_PRODUCT_UNPUBLISH
examined_formations.chinese_title: 供应商不可售触发商品下架
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Supplier availability can originate outside the retailer storefront, but Shopify Collective continuously syncs supplier inventory and lets retailers define policies that set inventory to zero, draft/unpublish, or delete products when they become unavailable. Shopify Flow also exposes native publish/unpublish automation. The external state is already absorbed into commerce control.

examined_formations.title: PAYMENT_GATEWAY_OUTAGE_TO_BACKUP_ROUTING
examined_formations.chinese_title: 支付网关故障触发备用通道路由
examined_formations.evidence_summary: A payment processor outage is an external provider event and routing to a backup gateway is a buyer-controlled action with direct revenue-continuity value. Recurly's Gateway Failover detects primary-gateway downtime or elevated communication errors and automatically reroutes live payments to a configured backup. The exact resilience loop is mature product functionality.
